author: TheFlamingPea
body:
Hello, 

My current IGN is unordinary btw.

I am here to ask if it would be possible for me to be un-banned. I have not been on the forums or the server (or really MC) for 2 months and did not realize i was banned until now. Looking at why I was banned made me a little mad because I am my own account. I am not an alt of the user Kavizie. Kavizie is my friend in real life so I go over to her house a lot on the weekends. I don't remember playing on Avicus while at her house whilst she was banned but we use to play MC a lot so maybe I did. I think the person who banned me must have thought that since I had the same IP as her on the weekends that I was her ALT. If you want, feel free to check my IP as I have not been over at her house in quite a while.

I would really appreciate if you could un-ban me or at least consider it as I have done nothing bad on this server other then hanging out with a banned person xD I would love for the chance to continue to play on this server :D

Thank you for your time,

Regards,

unordinary/Kafinity/OpticOwl
